# TechVit

TechVit is an independent software engineering and AI implementation practice in Japan.

- AI workflow assessment: https://www.techvit.me/services/ai-workflow-assessment/
- Automation development: https://www.techvit.me/services/automation-development/

- Customer insight analysis: https://www.techvit.me/services/customer-insight-analysis/

## How TechVit works

TechVit does not treat AI adoption itself as the goal. Work starts by identifying the workflow, constraints, bottlenecks, decision points, human-review requirements, risks, and measurable proof-of-concept scope.
